_about: Mission gallery slots to replace (or drop when no better image exists), from an eye review of all 608 live mission gallery images on 2026-11-08 plus a pHash duplicate scan. Operator decisions: diagrams out (A), unsourced replaced (E), patches (B), duplicates within and across galleries (C) and press-event shots (D) included; no better pick -> drop the slot.
